newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen off, IBM to weigh on Dow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen off, IBM to weigh on Dow.

text.p: A sell-off in shares of International Business Machines Corp is expected to take the Dow Industrials lower in early trading on Wednesday, analysts said.
But analysts said that a benign bond market and the rush of earnings reports, many of them favorable, should held the market despite weakness in blue chips.
"IBM is a major Dow component and it will hurt the average," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities.
"Yesterday, Boeing took the Dow up, today IBM is likely to take it down."
